import os,glob,re,json
d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
    k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
    rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
    if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
        G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]

def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    c4=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==4]
    c6=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==6]
    rs=[i for i,j in c4]; cs=[j for i,j in c4]
    top,bot,L,R=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    r6=[i for i,j in c6]; c6s=[j for i,j in c6]
    t6,b6,L6,R6=min(r6),max(r6),min(c6s),max(c6s)
    # arrow direction of 6-shape: bar of 3 horizontal + stem of 2
    cells6=set(c6)
    if len(c6)==5:
        # find bar: the row or col with 3 cells
        from collections import Counter
        rc=Counter(i for i,j in c6); cc=Counter(j for i,j in c6)
        barrow=[r for r,n in rc.items() if n==3]
        barcol=[c for c,n in cc.items() if n==3]
        if barrow:
            # horizontal bar; stem above or below?
            b=barrow[0]; stem=[i for i,j in c6 if j!=R6-L6+R6 and True]
            stemrows=sorted(set(i for i,j in c6 if i!=b))
            if stemrows and min(stemrows)<b: arrow='up'
            else: arrow='down'
            direc={'down':'right','up':'left'}[arrow]
        elif barcol:
            b=barcol[0]; stemcols=sorted(set(j for i,j in c6 if j!=b))
            if stemcols and min(stemcols)<b: arrow='left'
            else: arrow='right'
            direc={'right':'down','left':'up'}[arrow]
        else:
            direc='down'  # plus
    else:
        direc='down'
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for i,j in c6: out[i][j]=0
    if direc=='down':
        src=lambda i,j:(top+bot+1-i, j)  # reflect across row bot+0.5
        ok=lambda i,j: top+bot+1-i<h
    elif direc=='up':
        src=lambda i,j:(top+bot+1-i, j)
        ok=lambda i,j: top+bot+1-i>=0
    elif direc=='right':
        src=lambda i,j:(i, L+R+1-j); ok=lambda i,j: L+R+1-j<w
    else:
        src=lambda i,j:(i, L+R+1-j); ok=lambda i,j: L+R+1-j>=0
    for i,j in c4:
        si,sj=src(i,j)
        if ok(si,sj): out[si][sj]=4
    return out
